highlights.title: Lake views

properties.description: A magnificent heritage property on the banks of Lake Pichola, offering royale Rajasthani hospitality. The villa features three exquisitely decorated bedrooms, a private courtyard, and stunning lake views. Ideal for family getaways or romantic retreats in the City of Lakes.
properties.neighbourhoodHighlights: Steps from Lake Pichola and within walking distance of the iconic City Palace, Jagdish Temple, and the bustling old city bazaars. The area is rich in history and culture.

reviews.name: Rahul
reviews.text: Absolutely magical experience. The lake views from our room were incredible and the villa itself is stunning. Priya was an amazing host — very attentive and responsive.

reviews.name: Ananya
reviews.text: One of the best stays of our lives. The pool overlooking the lake is unreal. Heritage decor, impeccable cleanliness, excellent staff. Will definitely return!

reviews.name: Arjun
reviews.text: Perfect getaway. The property is exactly as described — spacious, beautifully decorated, and in a prime location. Self check-in was seamless.

reviews.name: Sneha
reviews.text: Beautiful property with stunning views. Excellent hospitality. Minor suggestion — the Wi-Fi could be faster, but overall a fantastic experience.

properties.neighbourhoodHighlights: Ideally located on City Palace Road, you're steps from the iconic City Palace, Jagmandir Island, and the vibrant Hathi Pol Bazaar.

reviews.name: Meera
reviews.text: The haveli is absolutely gorgeous. Every corner is beautifully decorated. The location is perfect — we could walk to the City Palace and back.

reviews.name: Karan
reviews.text: Great stay with excellent location. The rooftop restaurant serves amazing food. Room was clean and well-maintained.

reviews.name: Deepika
reviews.text: The most beautiful accommodation I've ever had. The heritage architecture is breathtaking and the hosts are incredibly welcoming.

reviews.name: Rohit
reviews.text: Lovely property with authentic character. The staff is courteous and helpful. Would highly recommend for a couple's getaway.

properties.description: An extraordinary penthouse perched above the shimmering Lake Pichola. Wake up to breathtaking 360° views of the lake, City Palace, and the Aravalli hills. This architectural masterpiece features a private rooftop infinity pool, open-air dining terrace, and interiors that seamlessly blend traditional Rajasthani craftsmanship with contemporary luxury.
properties.neighbourhoodHighlights: Situated in the heart of Udaipur's old city, you're surrounded by centuries of Rajput history. The City Palace, Jagdish Temple, and picturesque ghats are all within a 5-minute walk.

reviews.name: Nisha
reviews.text: This penthouse is an absolute dream. The infinity pool overlooking Lake Pichola is unlike anything I've experienced. Every detail is perfection.

reviews.name: Siddharth
reviews.text: Worth every rupee. The views are spectacular — watching the sunrise over the lake from the pool was life-changing. Impeccable service throughout.

reviews.name: Tara
reviews.text: Perfect anniversary celebration. The penthouse exceeded all our expectations. The hosts arranged special touches that made everything magical.

reviews.name: Dev
reviews.text: If you can afford it, book this place. The pool, the views, the interiors — all absolutely stunning. Best Airbnb stay in India, hands down.

Perfect for group getaways, family vacations, or corporate retreats.
properties.neighbourhoodHighlights: Assagao is Goa's most sought-after village — a serene escape with artisan cafes, boutique shops, and yoga studios. Baga Beach and Anjuna Market are just 10 minutes away.

reviews.name: Kunal
reviews.text: Absolute paradise! Spent 5 nights here with 7 friends and it was the trip of a lifetime. The pool is stunning, the staff is incredible, and the food they prepared was restaurant-quality.

reviews.name: Prerna
reviews.text: This villa is everything the photos promise and more. The greenery, the pool, the rooms — all perfect. The house manager was incredibly helpful and attentive.

reviews.name: Akash
reviews.text: Best vacation we've ever had in Goa. 8 of us stayed and everyone was blown away. The location in Assagao is quiet but still close to everything.

reviews.name: Divya
reviews.text: If you're visiting Goa with a group, this is the place to book. The villa is massive, impeccably maintained, and the pool is the star of the show.

reviews.name: Rajan

reviews.name: Aparna
